title: अह कैन यू टेल मी माय अह नेम?

messages.text: अह कैन यू टेल मी माय अह नेम?
आपका नाम साहिल है।
[Thud] Give me details about me.

Here are your details:
Your name is Sahil.
You are twenty-five years old.
Your date of birth is March thirtieth, two thousand one.
Your height is five feet ten inches.
Your weight is seventy-three kilograms.

Is there anything else you'd like to know?
Call me Vijay.
Okay, I'll call you Vijay.
Can you tell me what is my name?
Your name is Vijay.
कते ग Who is the PM of Who is the PM of

भारत के प्रधान मंत्री श्री नरेंद्र मोदी हैं। उन्होंने नौ जून, दो हज़ार चौबीस को तीसरी बार भारत के प्रधान मंत्री के रूप में शपथ ली।

क्या आप उनके बारे में कुछ और जानना चाहेंगे?
Call me samosa.
Okay, मैं आपको समोसा बुलाऊँगा।
Can you tell me my name again?

Your name is Samosa.

क्या आपको कुछ और जानना है?
Please tell me how many names I have given to you.
You have given me two names. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Which are they?

They are Vijay and Samosa.

Would you like to know anything else?
Can you tell me my real

Your real name is Sahil.

Is there anything else I can help you with?
